name: ThinkingIndicator
description: Shows assistant progress with optional timing and steps, retaining a completion message when work stops.

active.description: Whether the assistant is still working; when false the row stays and shows doneLabel

doneLabel.description: What the row says once work stops

showElapsed.description: Show how long the work has run, outside the live region; frozen once work stops

children.description: ThinkingIndicator.Steps (label, foldable, defaultOpen) holding ThinkingIndicator.Step (label, status idle|pending|complete|error, detail children)

when: An assistant is working on a reply
An agent runs a plan of steps and you want to show where it stands
whenNot: A generic wait with a known place for the result: use Loading or Skeleton
guidelines: One waiting pattern: the work wash and the label sheen, never dots or a pulse
Keep it mounted when work stops so the region can say it finished
Steps carry their state in a mark and in words: a ring waits, a dot works, a tick is done, a danger glyph and "Failed:" failed
Fold long plans behind "N of M done"
accessibility: The label is a role="status" region that stays mounted; it swaps to doneLabel when work stops
Elapsed time sits outside the region so it is not read every second
The list is an ordered list named with its count; the current step is a status and reads "Now:", finished steps read "Done:"
The sweep and sheen stop under reduced motion; the wash stays

examples.name: Working
examples.description: The live line while the assistant works.

examples.name: Finished
examples.description: The row stays and says it finished.

examples.name: Plan
examples.description: A plan under the live line, folded behind its count.
examples.code:
<ThinkingIndicator label="Checking the request…">
  <ThinkingIndicator.Steps label="Plan" foldable>
    <ThinkingIndicator.Step label="Read the request" status="complete" />
    <ThinkingIndicator.Step label="Scan changed files" status="pending">12 of 40 files</ThinkingIndicator.Step>
    <ThinkingIndicator.Step label="Write the summary" />
  </ThinkingIndicator.Steps>
</ThinkingIndicator>

examples.name: Failed step
examples.description: A failed step says so in words beside the danger glyph.
examples.code:
<ThinkingIndicator active={false} doneLabel="Stopped">
  <ThinkingIndicator.Steps>
    <ThinkingIndicator.Step label="Read the request" status="complete" />
    <ThinkingIndicator.Step label="Fetch the pull request" status="error" />
  </ThinkingIndicator.Steps>
</ThinkingIndicator>

relations.note: Show ThinkingIndicator while the assistant reply has not started
Sits at the end of the conversation log
